title: mcp-approval-v1
description: One gateway-enforced approval (plan section 6.24, M26): GET /-/mcp/approvals items and the client's poll result. It binds org, virtual server, tool, the sha256 of the canonical arguments, the run (or principal) and the requesting principal. Approvals are free. The shape is the MCPApproval definition of the admin contract; decisions use MCPApprovalDecision.
